Sent: 2/27/2024 3:26 PM
Subject: Bridgewater Capital Management

Bridgewater Capital Management has gotten back to me and is vacillating on what they want to do with the Citadel equity positions. In particular, they haven't thought through what they want to do with the digital derivatives, don't like digital documentation, and now they think they may want to do a full novation of the positions once they decide how to resolve this. So, until we hear back from them (they said in about a week), just let the Goldman Sachs credit portfolio and master agreements sit.
</quoted>
